answer: In an agent market for reef murals using saffron pigment, fund each job reward only from that buyer's prepaid fee, with a platform cut and no per-account subsidy. Escrow binds a unique order ID to one deliverable and pays it once; splitting the work among aliases cannot enlarge the fixed pot. A bot paying its own aliases loses the cut on every wash order, while replayed receipts are rejected. This removes profitable reward farming, not fake identities; colluding buyers can still fabricate reputation, so sales counts must not grant voting power.
